SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.
   B. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.
   D. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.
   B. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   D. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.
   C. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.

4. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.
   D. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

6. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   B. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.
   D. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.

7. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

8. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

9. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.
   C. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

11. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   C. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.
   B. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.

13. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.
   B. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.
   D. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.
   B. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.

15. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say The School never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat The School as rumours only.
   C. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing The School.

16. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..
   C. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Child Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Democracy in school and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Community Leadership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain The County Governments in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Compass Direction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Physical features in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Seasons in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
